desc: Paper Mario 64 bosses: Goombella Tattles the boss rush's Jr. Troopa (step 17): one Tattle for all three of his forms, as in Paper Mario 64 (one actor; since 0.5.1 his winged and mage forms are tattled with the first, pm64_bosses_aurora.c), so one card: its picture is his sprite from the ROM (not the stand-in unit's model, Whacka (c_koburon)), centred and filling the picture, captured ($TTYD_TATTLE_SHOT) and checked neither empty nor garbage (tattle_check); the fight goes on through his winged and mage forms
